summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Mid Cap Core ETF (AEMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed and invests primarily in mid-cap companies using fundamental and market-based factors. The fund seeks long-term growth of capital. AEMC was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AEMC is an equity ETF with a total of 100 individual holdings. The top holdings are Marathon Petroleum stock at 4.13%, NetApp at 3.17%, Comfort Systems USA at 3.04%, Ameriprise Financial at 3.03%, and IDEX Corporation at 2.83%.
